msg: The game goes pretty fast so make sure you are ready to press s, k and space. I think the gnomes work in pairs so if purple is doing well then red will do well, same with green and brown. They seem to start high 9 mushrooms and when the numbers get smaller then swap to the opposite colour - so when your purple and red combo start to get down to 4 or 2 mushrooms then try swapping to the green and brown combo. Who knows if that is right but I think it worked quite well for me! Have fun and good luck.
